tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Sign Navy, sampled from the park's interpretive sign. The brand's ink: headings, body text, header and footer grounds, primary buttons.

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of a navy fill.

tokens.name: ochre-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the Give button and the ochre card band, a step brighter than the sign's ochre so navy text reads on it (4.7:1).

tokens.name: ochre-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of an ochre-fill surface; navy text 5.7:1.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Mission Green, from the sign's heritage band. History bands and heritage accents; as text, on surface and surface-raised (6.8:1).

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: Brick, from the sign's map band. Visit and map bands, link hover, error text; as text, on surface and surface-raised (7.2:1).

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Ochre, from the sign's Thomas Fire band. Ornaments, rules, accent fills and band headings at 24px or larger only (3.3:1 with paper). Never small text.

tokens.name: ochre-deep
tokens.usage: Ochre darkened for small text on light grounds: eyebrows, fact labels. 5.2:1 on paper.

tokens.name: sandstone
tokens.usage: Sandstone, from the dry-stone ramparts. Chips, image placeholders, quiet dividers. navy text reads on it (9.8:1); ink-muted too (5.0:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Paper, the sign's ground. The page background and the text color on navy, green and brick.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, form fields, the giving panel: one step lighter than the page.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate section band and form panels, between paper and sandstone. Inputs (surface-raised) sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-dark
tokens.usage: Dark sections: site footer, quote bands, the booking steps band.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and section dividers on surface. Not for anything a user must see to operate (use line-strong).

tokens.name: line-on-dark
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines on navy grounds: footer dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, chip and card borders that must be seen: 3.9:1 on surface-raised, 3.6:1 on surface, 3.3:1 on surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised, surface-alt and sandstone (9.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on surface, surface-raised, surface-alt (5.9:1 or better) and sandstone (5.0:1).

tokens.name: ink-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on navy (12.8:1), green (6.8:1), brick (7.2:1) and on photos behind scrim.

tokens.name: ink-on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on navy (9.1:1), green (4.9:1) and brick (5.1:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in body copy, always underlined.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover and active color on surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Decorative accent: the dotted-O ornament, rules, active nav underline, eyebrows set 24px or larger.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Eyebrows and accent text under 24px on surface (5.2:1), surface-raised (5.6:1) and surface-alt (4.7:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ochre-fill: the Give button label, the ochre card band (4.7:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ring in focus outside a 2px gap of surface. The gap keeps it visible on navy grounds and photos.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors. Always with the circle-alert icon and words; never color alone.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations. Always with the check icon and words; never color alone.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Navy scrim behind text on photos. Body text over photos sits only where the scrim reaches this strength (6.9:1 worst case on white).

tokens.name: scrim-soft
tokens.usage: Top of a hero gradient, behind the transparent header and its nav labels (4.8:1 worst case on white).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Strong Glasgow, always set in capitals like the park's signs. Its lowercase letters are small caps, so type it in sentence case and let the style uppercase it.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero titles, the site's title slides. One per page. Drops to 46px under 640px wide.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles and big section openers. 36px under 640px wide.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings and SignPanel band titles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, buttons, form labels, chips. The smallest size the display face is used at.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: EB Garamond, the closest open match to the sign's Garamond body text. Old-style figures in running text; lining figures in forms, prices and tables.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A one-acre park on the hill above Mission San Buenaventura, with the Pacific and the Channel Islands below.
styles.usage: The first paragraph of a page or section. One per section.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Gates lock at eight. Weekend events wrap by seven thirty so guests and vendors can clear the hill.
styles.usage: All running text. Keep lines under the measure size token.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Chairs are not provided. Rent seating from an outside company.
styles.usage: Card text, form help, footer text.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: The Cross at sunset, looking toward the Channel Islands.
styles.usage: Photo captions and archival credits, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label to input, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, list item spacing.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter, input padding, card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter, card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Heading to body, form field groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero padding and the gap before the footer.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The default, like the sign: photos, bands, buttons, cards.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips and checkboxes, just enough to soften the pixel edge.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Circles only: the FAQ toggle.

tokens.name: shadow-sticky
tokens.usage: The hairline under the site header once the page scrolls.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The open mobile menu and any dialog.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width. Photos and bands may bleed past it.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of a column of body text.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header height on desktop; 64px on mobile.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons, inputs and chips.
